By 2005, he had returned to Australia and set up a music school Rosies's School of Rock in Newcastle focusing on performance & band coaching for kids.  His portrait, "Rock and role model" by Peter Sesselmann, was entered for the 2009 Archibald Prize.  In 2017 Rosevear won the Newcastle Heat of the Real Estate Institute of NSW Auctioneering Competition.

Jet Plane | Jet Plane is the debut mini album by Japanese rock band Rumania Montevideo.  The mini album was released on January 30, 1999, by indies label "Garage Indies Zapping Association".  The album was reprinted on March 5, 1999.

39 Steps (band) | 39 Steps were a Canadian alternative rock/punk rock band from Montreal, Quebec best known for their single "Slip into the Crowd", a song they originally performed in the late 1970s as The 222s, which they are featured playing in the Woody Allen film "Hannah and Her Sisters" in a scene set at CBGB's NYC.
The Golden Band | The Golden Band is a studio album by the indie rock band The American Analog Set.  It was released on July 6, 1999 on Emperor Jones Records.
